topics.title: Building with AI
topics.subtitle: Practical ways to turn AI capability into useful, dependable work.
topics.description: Principles, experiments and reusable methods for building with AI. Explore how to define the right problem, design human-led workflows, test what matters and improve results without wasting time or resources.

art.alt: Cobalt and glass building blocks form a bridge traced by an amber path, illustrating purposeful construction with AI.

topics.title: AI Access & Independence
topics.subtitle: Fair access, meaningful choice and independence in an AI-shaped world.
topics.description: Ideas for making capable AI accessible without surrendering choice. Explore shared infrastructure, open models, provider competition, affordability and the responsibilities that come with technological independence.

art.alt: An open plaza connects varied cobalt and ivory pavilions around a shared golden track, suggesting fair access and independent choice.
